scope: Read-only audit of archived IEM predictions; original numerical files are preserved. This is not a rerun or corrected biological accuracy estimate.
findings: The old parser included six literal if-0 IEM calls and eight commented-out biomarker rows: 63 calls/279 entries instead of 57 active IEMs/252 entries.
Three CPS1 biomarker pairs with Time limit reached in both states were converted to healthy=0/disease=0 and scored as biological Unchanged. Numerical failure is unknown, not zero.

Demand sinks persisted between IEMs, although runIEM_HH resets model=modelO for each block. This creates run-order, shard, and resume dependence; simply filtering old result rows does not repair the predictions.
The Python joint IEM objective omitted the source auxiliary-variable bound of +/-100000. HYPRO1 has archived vmax 115903.17991535075, which is impossible under the source cap.
Additional source demand reactions that were not scored biomarkers were omitted from the Python setup. The corrected protocol explicitly lists these demands.
The archived summary is stale and describes 63 attempted IEMs and 19 scored biomarkers, whereas available result shards contain 45 records and 186 biomarker records.
Physiological and EU average diet preprocessing remains unported, so even the corrected engine on shipped bounds is exploratory.

The IEM solver hard-coded threads=1 and ignored h.run() errors. Running after another HiGHS instance initialized a different scheduler returned Not Set/NaN. Default threads=0 now cooperates with the process-wide scheduler; run errors raise explicitly.
The parser omitted direct IEM bound changes and find(ismember(...)) bounds. EP therefore missed its source _XYLUR irreversibility constraint; corrected extraction includes the source per-IEM tweaks.
implemented_corrections: Solver-status and finite-value gating; failed pairs are NA/unscored
Temporary demand and reaction-bound isolation with exception-safe cleanup
Explicit source demand lists and comment/disabled-branch filtering
New v0.2 protocol/output namespace; resume fingerprint validates model/protocol/settings and retries partial runs
Strict JSON null for unavailable numbers; accuracy is accompanied by coverage
Cooperate with existing HiGHS scheduler without resetting global state; report h.run errors
Extract source per-IEM bounds including direct IEM selections and find(ismember(...))

verification.scheduler_integration_regression: Initializes HiGHS scheduler with 2 threads, verifies default IEM solver reuses it, explicit incompatible threads=1 raises, and previous solver remains usable.

remaining_limitations: Harvey 1.03d model input is absent from this checkout; no full-model rerun was performed.
Physiological/diet conditions and source-specific numerical fallback behavior require a separately validated port.
The source extractor handles documented literal and whole-body branches, not arbitrary MATLAB evaluation; future source changes need review.
Whole-body IEM LPs still lack independently recomputed feasibility/optimality certificates; paired optimum directions alone do not identify metabolite concentrations.
The broader bile-duct reaction matching and exact-reaction versus substring matching have not been validated against the absent full model.
